blockers.issue: Assignment rule is internally contradictory, so Q and therefore the training objective and exported SIDs are not uniquely recomputable.
blockers.evidence: math_definition.assignment.rule specifies full-population Sinkhorn at every level, with N=24556 rows and uniform column mass 1/256. math_definition.assignment.prefix_diversity instead requires levels 2 and 3 to construct separate populations within each prefix and run balanced transport within each prefix, retaining prefixes. These yield different row populations, column constraints, and assignments. The special fewer-than-256 fallback is also not reconciled with the global rule. Since Q is used in reconstruction, commitment, transition targets, and hard SID export, this is an unresolved target/algorithm definition, not merely a diagnostic detail.

blockers.issue: The stated residual/code assignment path does not uniquely specify which quantized code is subtracted to form subsequent residuals.
blockers.evidence: operation_order says subtract the selected/soft-expected code; residual_order says subtract code from the unprojected residual; objective defines qbar as a soft expectation for reconstruction, while hard code is separately defined as argmax Q for export. It never selects one of hard code, soft qbar, or projected code for the residual update. Those choices change the level-2/3 residual populations and cannot be inferred uniquely.

reproducible_evidence.scope: Audit uses only the current-only manifest supplied in the request; no repository implementation or unseen validation/test interactions were inspected.
reproducible_evidence.math: The displayed Poincare squared-distance expression is mathematically equivalent to the standard distance for c>0 and the stated strict projection bound keeps c||x||^2 <= 0.405 < 1. Its declared c-to-zero limit 4||x-y||^2 is correct. The Euclidean control shares the fixed radius and differs in scored distance, so no blocker on the metric control itself.
reproducible_evidence.causal_and_leakage: Train-only directed transitions motivate the directional objective but do not establish curvature necessity or causal gain; the manifest explicitly states that limitation. Optimization inputs exclude validation/test behavior, future events, and prediction-time user context. Validation is read-only and test is designated for one downstream Stage3 evaluation.
reproducible_evidence.registered_behavior_test: Stage3 registers test_R@10, curved-minus-flat positive direction, minimum effect 0.005, paired seed set [42], and fixed protocol with no validation checkpoint selection or test-based fitting/threshold adjustment. Its classification specifies pass/falsified/inconclusive including NULL handling.
reproducible_evidence.stage2_indicators: The registered comparisons include validation valid_l1_hard_er, level2_distinct_prefixes, and conditional_G3 (same validation pairs, prescribed estimator, NULL policy). Admission thresholds are strictly >10.0 and >16145. Stage2 is not presented as a ranking test. The missing/contradictory assignment definition prevents these diagnostics from being reproducibly generated.
